items.label: Daily Loss Limit
items.detail: 25k:$625 | 50k:$1,250 | 100k:$2,500 | 150k:$3,750. Warning + recovery window. No instant termination.

items.label: Max Drawdown
items.detail: 25k:$1,250 | 50k:$2,500 | 100k:$3,500 | 150k:$5,000. Trails at EOD. Locks at Starting Balance + $100 post-payout.

items.label: Consistency Rule
items.detail: Strictest tier. Single day profit ≤ 20% of cycle total. Extend cycle to normalize ratio before payout request.

items.label: Guardian Shield
items.detail: Auto-closes all trades at −2% floating loss. Protects capital from rapid intraday drawdowns.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: ±5 min Red Folder ban. Clear orders ±2 min all news. Firm not liable for slippage or platform sync issues.

items.label: CME Price Limit
items.detail: No trading within 2% of CME limit. Prevents gap exposure during limit-up/down sessions.

items.label: Risk/Reward & Stops
items.detail: Initial SL required. Disciplined sizing only. Unplanned large contracts or revenge trading triggers review.

items.label: Automation & Scalping
items.detail: AI/bots banned. Microscalping & >200 trades/day prohibited. Martingale allowed within margin constraints.

items.label: Trading Hours
items.detail: Auto-close at 16:10 EST (no breach). Weekend holds allowed per exchange schedule.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: 100% first $15k, 90% thereafter. Processed ≤48h via RiseWorks. No hidden fees.

items.label: Frequency & Conditions
items.detail: Requires 10 net-positive days. Min $500 withdrawal. Rolling 14-day cycle from last payout.

items.label: Payout Targets
items.detail: No eval target. Withdraw upon meeting consistency, min days, & soft breach rules.

items.label: Account Type
items.detail: Skip eval phase. Activation fee $149 charged ONLY if account becomes profitable.

items.label: Max Accounts
items.detail: Max 3 concurrent funded accounts. Additional accounts require separate eval subscriptions.

items.label: KYC & Compliance
items.detail: Full Veriff KYC/AML required. One profile per trader. Restricted regions blocked automatically.
